verdict.rationale: Founder Law publishes open web pages on startup-relevant visas: an International Entrepreneur Parole page with current CPI-adjusted qualifying thresholds, an EB-1A self-petition explainer, and a Techstars immigration library covering parole, green cards and the path to citizenship, meant to be read at your own pace. But the library is framed as packaged for Techstars members, the deeper Extraordinary Ability Bootcamp is a paid course, and several pages funnel into case-assessment forms, so how substantial and truly ungated the free content is remains unclear. Missing for 10: step-by-step process explainers, real case examples or success stories, confirmation that the Techstars library is open to non-members, and independent corroboration of guide depth.
